# Risk Assessment & Method Statement (RAMS)

---

## 1. Scope of Work

This RAMS covers standard on-site IT services including:
- Collection of IT equipment (laptops, desktops, servers, peripherals)
- On-site hardware diagnostics and repair
- Data destruction and media sanitization
- Network infrastructure assessment

---

## 2. Hazard Identification & Control Measures

| Hazard | Risk Level | Control Measures |
|--------|------------|------------------|
| **Manual Handling** (lifting equipment) | Medium | Assess load before lifting. Use proper technique. Request assistance for items >15kg. Use trolley/sack truck for bulk collections. |
| **Electrical Safety** | Medium | Visual inspection before handling. Do not handle visibly damaged equipment while powered. Isolate power before internal work. |
| **Sharps/Broken Equipment** | Low | Wear protective gloves when handling damaged devices. Inspect equipment before packing. |
| **Slips, Trips, Falls** | Low | Assess site conditions on arrival. Keep work area clear. Use appropriate footwear. |
| **Data Security** | High | Chain of custody maintained at all times. Equipment secured in locked vehicle. NIST 800-88 sanitization applied to all storage media. |
| **Lone Working** | Medium | Inform office of location and expected duration. Mobile phone carried at all times. Check-in protocol for extended visits. |

---

## 3. Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)

| Equipment | When Required |
|-----------|---------------|
| Safety footwear | All on-site collections |
| Protective gloves | Handling damaged or unknown equipment |
| Hi-visibility vest | Warehouse/industrial site visits |

---

## 4. Emergency Procedures

- **Fire:** Evacuate immediately via nearest exit. Do not attempt to retrieve equipment.
- **Injury:** Administer first aid if trained. Call 999 for serious injuries.
- **Spillage:** Report to site manager. Do not handle chemical spills.

**Emergency Contact:** Jake Fieldhouse — +44 7404 090458

---

## 5. Environmental Considerations

- All collected equipment processed under Environment Agency Waste Carrier License (CBDL620098)
- Zero Landfill policy — equipment refurbished, recycled, or responsibly disposed
- Hazardous materials (batteries, CRTs) handled by licensed downstream partners
